firstrun.asleep_bubble.note: The bubble of the first Imp when the app opens for the first time.
firstrun.asleep_bubble.en: {name} is asleep. Give it a Brain to wake it up.
firstrun.asleep_bubble.es: {name} está dormido. Dale un cerebro para despertarlo.
firstrun.asleep_bubble.zh-Hans: {name} 睡着了。给它一个大脑，就能叫醒它。

firstrun.check.ok.note: The check worked. The Imp wakes up.

firstrun.check.running.note: Shown while the Brain is checked. The Imp stirs.

firstrun.error.address.note: The typed service address is not an http or https address.
firstrun.error.address.en: That address does not look right. It starts with https:// or http://.
firstrun.error.address.es: Esa dirección no parece correcta. Empieza con https:// o http://.
firstrun.error.address.zh-Hans: 这个地址看起来不对。它应以 https:// 或 http:// 开头。

firstrun.error.empty_key.note: Error when the key field is empty.
firstrun.error.empty_key.zh-Hans: 请粘贴你的密钥后再继续。

firstrun.error.key_not_saved.note: The check worked, but the key could not be stored.
firstrun.error.key_not_saved.en: Imp could not save the key. Try again.
firstrun.error.key_not_saved.es: Imp no pudo guardar la clave.
firstrun.error.key_not_saved.zh-Hans: Imp 无法保存密钥。请再试一次。

firstrun.error.no_model.zh-Hans: 请选择一个模型再继续。

firstrun.model.search.note: Placeholder of the model field. It filters the list, or takes a name typed by hand.

firstrun.service.address.note: Field label of the service address.

firstrun.service.found.note: Tooltip of the dot in Local when a model server answers on this Mac.
firstrun.service.found.zh-Hans: 在这台 Mac 上找到

firstrun.service.host_note.note: Quiet line on the phone under a local preset: the address is the computer's.
firstrun.service.host_note.en: Use the address of your computer on this network.
firstrun.service.host_note.es: Usa la dirección de tu equipo en esta red.
firstrun.service.host_note.zh-Hans: 请填写你电脑在这个网络里的地址。

firstrun.service.loading.note: Shown while the models of the service are loaded.

firstrun.service.note.note: The one quiet line under the service fields.
firstrun.service.note.en: Any OpenAI-compatible API. Your key stays on this device.
firstrun.service.note.es: Cualquier API compatible con OpenAI. Tu clave se queda en este dispositivo.
firstrun.service.note.zh-Hans: 任何兼容 OpenAI 的 API。密钥只保存在这台设备上。

firstrun.step.model.note: Name of step 2 in the first-run step indicator.

firstrun.step.service.note: Name of step 1 in the first-run step indicator.

firstrun.service.remote.note: The service choice for a model in the cloud, used with a key.

firstrun.service.local.note: The service choice for a model server on your own computer.

firstrun.service.key_local.note: Placeholder of the disabled key field when a local model is chosen.
firstrun.service.key_local.es: No hace falta para modelos locales

firstrun.service.kind.note: Screen reader name of the Remote or Local choice.

firstrun.link.note: Footer button of the first run on the Mac: bring an Imp from another device instead.

firstrun.link.help.note: Tooltip of that button: opens the Link sheet.
firstrun.link.help.en: Link a device and bring an Imp from it instead
firstrun.link.help.es: Vincula un dispositivo y trae un Imp de él
firstrun.link.help.zh-Hans: 连接设备，改为从它带来一个 Imp

onboarding.step.model.note: Title of step 1 of the first run.
onboarding.step.model.zh-Hans: 你的 Imp 有了大脑

onboarding.step.move.note: Title of step 2 of the first run.
onboarding.step.move.en: Send your Imp to another screen
onboarding.step.move.es: Pasa a tu Imp a otra pantalla
onboarding.step.move.zh-Hans: 把你的 Imp 送到另一块屏幕

onboarding.step.setup.note: Title of step 3 of the first run.
onboarding.step.setup.en: Let your Imp set itself up
onboarding.step.setup.es: Deja que tu Imp se configure solo
onboarding.step.setup.zh-Hans: 让你的 Imp 自己完成设置

onboarding.step.of.note: Which step of the first run this is.

onboarding.model.issuing.note: Step 1 while the key is being issued.

onboarding.model.ready.note: Step 1 once the model is connected. The host is the service's address.

onboarding.model.form.note: Step 1 in a build without a model service: what to do.
onboarding.model.form.en: Connect the model your Imp thinks with.
onboarding.model.form.es: Conecta el modelo con el que piensa tu Imp.
onboarding.model.form.zh-Hans: 连接你的 Imp 用来思考的模型。

onboarding.retry.title.note: Step 1 when the key could not be issued.
onboarding.retry.title.en: Your model is not ready yet
onboarding.retry.title.es: Tu modelo aún no está listo
onboarding.retry.title.zh-Hans: 你的模型还没有准备好

onboarding.retry.body.note: Step 1 after a failure that trying again can fix.
onboarding.retry.body.en: Nothing is lost. Try again in a moment.
onboarding.retry.body.es: No se ha perdido nada. Inténtalo de nuevo en un momento.
onboarding.retry.body.zh-Hans: 没有任何损失。请稍后再试。

onboarding.retry.wait.note: Step 1 when the service asks to wait. The number is seconds.
onboarding.retry.wait.en: You can try again in {seconds} seconds.
onboarding.retry.wait.es: Podrás intentarlo de nuevo en {seconds} segundos.

onboarding.retry.final.note: Step 1 after a failure that trying again cannot fix.
onboarding.retry.final.en: This service is not handing out models right now. You can connect your own instead.
onboarding.retry.final.es: Este servicio no entrega modelos ahora mismo. Puedes conectar el tuyo.
onboarding.retry.final.zh-Hans: 这个服务目前不提供模型。你可以改为连接自己的模型。

onboarding.retry.details.note: Button that shows what the service said.

onboarding.move.body.note: Step 2: how an Imp goes to another device.
onboarding.move.body.en: Give your Imp a quick swipe toward the edge of the screen. It is carried over to the screen of your other device with Imp. Swipe it back to bring it home.
onboarding.move.body.es: Dale a tu Imp un empujón rápido hacia el borde de la pantalla. Se va a la pantalla de tu otro dispositivo con Imp. Empújalo de vuelta para traerlo a casa.
onboarding.move.body.zh-Hans: 朝屏幕边缘快速一划，你的 Imp 就会被送到你另一台装有 Imp 的设备屏幕上。再划回来就能让它回家。

onboarding.setup.body.note: Step 3: what the prompt is for.
onboarding.setup.body.en: Your Imp starts with these words. You can change them first.
onboarding.setup.body.es: Tu Imp empieza con estas palabras. Puedes cambiarlas antes.
onboarding.setup.body.zh-Hans: 你的 Imp 会从这段话开始。你可以先修改它。

onboarding.prompt.note: What a new Imp is asked first, on a computer. Plain words only, no tool names.
onboarding.prompt.en: Hi! Make 5 animations for different emotions. And when I click on you, open the box where I can type to you.
onboarding.prompt.es: ¡Hola! Crea 5 animaciones para distintas emociones. Y cuando haga clic en ti, abre la caja donde puedo escribirte.
onboarding.prompt.zh-Hans: 你好！帮我做 5 个表达不同情绪的动画。还有，当我点击你的时候，打开可以给你打字的输入框。

onboarding.prompt.field.es: Lo que se le pide a tu Imp
onboarding.prompt.field.zh-Hans: 对你的 Imp 的请求

onboarding.prompt.send_again.note: Button that sends the setup prompt to the Imp again.

onboarding.prompt.reset.note: Button that restores the preset prompt.

onboarding.change_connection.note: Action that opens the form for an address, a key and a model.

onboarding.setup_prompt.note: Action that opens the setup prompt.

onboarding.use_included.note: Action that goes back to the model that came with the app.
onboarding.use_included.en: Use the model that came with Imp
onboarding.use_included.es: Usar el modelo que viene con Imp
onboarding.use_included.zh-Hans: 使用 Imp 自带的模型

onboarding.creating.note: Message while the Imp is being created.

api.out_of_credit.note: Error: the service has no credit left. The message is the service's own and says how to top up.

onboarding.model.body.note: Step 1: what the model is for, in one plain sentence.
onboarding.model.body.en: This is what lets your Imp understand you and talk back.
onboarding.model.body.es: Es lo que permite a tu Imp entenderte y responderte.
onboarding.model.body.zh-Hans: 有了它，你的 Imp 才能听懂你的话并回答你。

onboarding.prompt.tap.note: What a new Imp is asked first, on a phone, where an Imp is tapped. Plain words only, no tool names.
onboarding.prompt.tap.en: Hi! Make 5 animations for different emotions. And when I tap on you, open the box where I can type to you.
onboarding.prompt.tap.es: ¡Hola! Crea 5 animaciones para distintas emociones. Y cuando te toque, abre la caja donde puedo escribirte.
onboarding.prompt.tap.zh-Hans: 你好！帮我做 5 个表达不同情绪的动画。还有，当我点一下你的时候，打开可以给你打字的输入框。
